figures.title: This paper in the 13 components, against the field
figures.subtitle: Each box: what this paper does, then common practice across all sensors and how many ledger papers share it.
figures.caption: Verdicts compare the paper's choice for each component with common practice across 8,995 ledger entries on any sensor (silent speech, brain-to-text, lip reading).

M01.note: Silent speech is never used for training.

choice: Audio force-aligned phone labels for a visual bottleneck
M02.note: 49 phone classes from modal audio alignment.

choice: SAT with fMLLR; unsupervised adaptation on each test set
M03.note: Unsupervised adaptation was prior work [@wand2014towards]; here scored on its own adaptation data.

choice: Modal-trained decoder tested on silent and modal, prompt-matched
M04.field: Overt-trained decoder applied to silent speech

choice: Midsagittal ultrasound about 80 fps plus lip video
In-domain bigram LM on a prompt superset

M11.note: Same sentences read silently and aloud.

choice: WER on seen speakers; single runs
M12.note: No speaker held out and no seeds or tests; [@wang2015speaker] held speakers out.
